description:
'''Gabber''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|ɡ|æ|b|ər}} {{respell|GAB|ər}}; {{IPA|nl|ˈɣɑbər|lang|nl-gabber.ogg}}) is a style of [[electronic dance music]] and a subgenre of [[Hardcore (electronic dance music genre)|hardcore]], as well as the surrounding subculture. The music is characterised by fast beats, distorted and heavy kickdrums, with dark themes and samples.

It formed as an underground, anti-establishment movement with small, underground raves, most often illegally held in empty warehouses, basements, and tunnels. Gabber remains highly popular in the [[Netherlands]], and has seen a major resurgence in the late 2010s. 

[[Rave]] parties such as [[Thunderdome (music festival)|Thunderdome]], held by [[ID&T]] and [[Mysteryland]], became hugely popular, eventually becoming part of mainstream Dutch culture in the 1990s. The music and culture quickly spread across Europe and the world, finding a home with the rave communities in countries such as the UK, Spain, Italy, US, and Australia.
